stories.notes: Two friends find the owner of a red umbrella. Practice colors, possession, places, and simple questions.
A learner orders soy milk and buns, then shares a table with a neighbor. Practice numbers, food, politeness, and likes.
A new neighbor needs help carrying a plant upstairs. Practice introductions, directions, home vocabulary, and offering help.

stories.topic: Getting home after an evening class
stories.notes: Two classmates narrowly miss the last bus and solve the problem together. Practice time, transport, plans, and reassurance.

stories.topic: A bookshop cat leads to a discovery
stories.notes: A familiar cat disappears among the shelves, leading the owner and a customer to an old note. Keep the mystery warm, not frightening.
Friends navigate gardens, canals, food, changing weather, and a small misunderstanding while traveling respectfully.

stories.topic: A lantern with an unfinished inscription
stories.notes: At a community lantern event, students trace the maker of a lantern that bears no name and learn why it was left unsigned.

stories.topic: A parcel delivered to the wrong apartment
stories.notes: A mistaken delivery connects three neighbors and reveals a thoughtful surprise. Use natural apartment and messaging vocabulary.

stories.topic: An old photograph and a changed riverfront
stories.notes: A photographer returns to match an old image with the modern city and finds the person who took it. Explore memory and urban change.

stories.topic: A disagreement about preserving a neighborhood teahouse
stories.notes: Several generations debate renovation, tradition, and practical survival before finding a nuanced compromise.

stories.topic: A letter hidden inside a repaired clock
stories.notes: A clock repairer discovers a decades-old letter and weighs whether delivering it will heal or disrupt a family. Use subtle motives and layered dialogue.

stories.topic: A hand-drawn map found during courtyard repairs
stories.notes: Residents investigate a map beneath an old courtyard and uncover the neighborhood's shared history rather than treasure. End with communal renewal.
